template.name: SMB Magic
template.entry_long: close > donchian_high_prev(high,{p0}) and volume_ratio(volume,{p1}) > {p0} and close > ema(close,{p2}) and high - low > {p1} * atr(high,low,close,14)
template.notes: The documented rule combines a large-candle breakout, volume confirmation and an EMA filter, but no numeric values are supplied, so the 20-bar channel, 1.5x volume ratio, EMA(50) and 1.5x ATR candle size are explicit fallbacks. Balance-based position sizing and the documented risk models are not signals.
